result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and continuous sidewalks in a mixed-use residential and commercial area. However, safety is compromised by the lack of visible traffic control devices and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the crossing points.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners obscure the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the intersection near the crosswalks

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow at this four-way intersection, increasing the risk of collisions.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalks to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Installation
interventions.description: Install stop signs or traffic signals to clearly define right-of-way at the intersection.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and sidewalks on both sides of a two-lane street. However, safety is impacted by degraded pavement conditions and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the corners.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection limit the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line near the crosswalk on both sides of the street.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven road surface within the intersection and crosswalk area could cause tripping or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground of the image, specifically within the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and worn asphalt to provide a smoother surface for all users.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and curb ramps. However, visibility is compromised by parked vehicles near the corners, and the crossing distance lacks mid-block refuge or curb extensions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners obstruct the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center-left foreground near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway in one stage without a median or refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure at a signalized crossing. However, safety is compromised by parked vehicles obstructing sightlines at the corners and the absence of dedicated pedestrian signal heads.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the intersection and crosswalk area.

interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.
